speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing a new movement disorder alongside a psychiatric condition; to begin our workup, have you noticed any tremors, stiffness, or changes in your balance, and when did these symptoms first start?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Tardive Dyskinesia secondary to risperidone therapy.

Given your history of schizophrenia treated with risperidone for two months, your new movement disorder is likely a side effect of this medication. I will request your medical images now to confirm the specific type of involuntary movements you are experiencing.
